user missed a push or wants to re-read offers, charging, wallet, or payment alerts.

**Filters**
- `category` — `OFFER` | `CHARGING` | `WALLET` | `PAYMENT` | `SYSTEM`
- `unreadOnly=true` — only unread; `false` — only read; omit — both
- `page` / `pageSize` — standard pagination (max 100)

Expired rows (`expiresAt` in the past) are omitted. Empty inbox returns `data: []` with `total: 0`.

**Mobile flow:** open Notifications → call this → on tap, deep-link via `data` and
`POST /notifications/me/{id}/read`. Poll `GET /notifications/me/unread-count` for the badge.

info.title: Zetra API
info.description:
REST API for the Zetra EV charging platform (CSMS / OCPP).

All endpoints live under `/api/v1/...`.
Operation paths in this document already include that prefix, so the
server URL is left as `/` (same-origin). See `docs/API_OVERVIEW.md`.

## Docs surfaces

- **Full (admin + mobile):** `/api/docs`
- **Mobile / driver only:** `/api/mobile-docs` — Discover, Auth, Intents, Sessions, Wallet, Payments.

## How to authenticate (Try it out)

1. Call **`POST /auth/login`** (or register) and copy `accessToken` from the response.
2. Click **Authorize** (lock icon, top-right of this page).
3. In **bearer**, paste the access token only (do **not** type the word `Bearer`).
4. Optionally set **organizationId** (`X-Organization-Id`) if your user belongs to multiple orgs.
5. Click **Authorize**, then **Close**, then use **Try it out** on any protected endpoint.

Protected operations also expose `Authorization` and `X-Organization-Id` header fields
in the Try it out form. Prefer the top **Authorize** dialog so the token applies to every request.

**Drivers:** do **not** call `GET /stations` or `/organizations/current/*` — use **Discover** instead.

vehicleNumber.description: Registration plate. Normalised to upper-case alphanumerics with optional dashes. Unique per organization.

network.description: Network counts at the time the report ran (stations, chargers online/offline/fault, active sessions).

today.description: Today (UTC) totals. `revenueTodayPaise` and `walletBalanceTotalPaise` are null for callers without `tenant.session.cost_read`.

topCustomers.description: Top customers by lifetime spend across the window. Each entry: `{ id, name, email, sessionCount, energyWh, lifetimeSpendPaise }`. Money columns are masked to null for callers without `session.cost_read`.

topVehicles.description: Top vehicles by session count: `{ id, vehicleNumber, sessionCount, energyWh }`.

stations.description: Per-station utilization: `{ id, name, sessionCount, busyHours, utilizationPct }`. `utilizationPct` = busyHours / availableHours.

byPlaceOfSupply.description: Per-place-of-supply breakdown (CGST+SGST → intra-state buckets, IGST → inter-state).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key. Re-submitting the same key returns the existing payment.

returnUrl.description: Return URL the hosted checkout should redirect to after capture.

description.description: Optional free-text description shown on the receipt.

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted checkout URL — present when the provider redirects.

duplicate.description: True when the same idempotency key has been seen before.

userId.description: Customer (driver) user id the payment is being posted against.

method.description: Payment method as recorded by the operator. Defaults to `CASH`.

reason.description: Reason for the refund (audited). Minimum 6 characters. Surfaced in the customer receipt and operator timeline.

note.description: Operator note. Stored verbatim on the wallet ledger row.

amount.description: Partial-refund amount in major currency units. Omit for a full refund of the remaining captured amount.

refund.description: Refund row. `status` is `PROCESSED` on success; `walletTransactionId` is set when the wallet was credited.

note.description: Optional operator note attached to the registry row (≤ 200 chars).

code.description: Public voucher code. Stored exactly as provided; lookups are case-insensitive.

title.description: Short campaign title shown to redeemers.

creditAmount.description: Wallet credit awarded on redemption, in major currency units.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Defaults to organization currency.

maxRedemptions.description: Cap on the total number of redemptions across all users.

perUserLimit.description: Per-user cap (defaults to 1 at the service layer).

businessUnitId.description: Optional BU scope. When set, the offer applies to sessions whose station rolls up under this BU (or any descendant in the hierarchy).

code.description: Optional public coupon code. Omit for automatically-applied offers.

title.description: Short title shown in apps and on receipts.

discountValue.description: Percentage (0-100) when `discountType=PERCENTAGE`, otherwise absolute amount in major currency units.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency. Defaults to organization currency.

minSessionAmount.description: Minimum session amount required to apply the offer (in major currency units).

maxDiscount.description: Hard cap on absolute discount when using `PERCENTAGE` type.

priority.description: Ranking when multiple offers are eligible. Higher wins; ties broken by computed discount (descending).

stationId.description: Optional station scope. Most specific override; beats any BU-level tariff for sessions on this station.

businessUnitId.description: Optional BU scope (Phase 2B). Applies to the BU and all of its descendants in the hierarchy. Evaluated after the station override and before the organization default.

name.description: Human-readable tariff name shown on receipts and dashboards.

pricePerKwh.description: Energy rate in major currency units per kWh.

pricePerMinute.description: Optional idle/occupancy rate in major currency units per minute.

connectionFee.description: Optional flat per-session fee in major currency units.

cgstRate.description: CGST rate as a percentage (e.g. 9.00 = 9%). Applied alongside SGST when the tariff is intra-state.

sgstRate.description: SGST rate as a percentage. Must accompany `cgstRate` (both set or both omitted).

igstRate.description: IGST rate as a percentage. Applied (mutually exclusive with CGST+SGST) when `isInterState=true`.

isInterState.description: When true, calculations use IGST; otherwise CGST+SGST. Operator-set per tariff (e.g. for stations near a state border).

taxRegion.description: Optional jurisdiction code (e.g. `IN-KA`). Informational today; used by future country-specific tax regimes.

isDefault.description: Marks this tariff as the organization’s fallback when no station-specific tariff matches.

discountAmount.description: Optional flat-amount discount in major currency units (e.g. 50 = ₹50).
